effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Aqua] or [Sea Animal] in any of its traits and 1 card with the [LIBERATOR] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] Gain 1 memory.
